svg.title: A SIEM: collect, normalize, store, correlate
svg.desc: Logs flow from firewalls, endpoints, servers, applications, cloud APIs, and authentication systems into the SIEM, which normalizes them into a common schema, stores them, and correlates across sources. Example rule: a failed login to account A, a successful login to A five minutes later from a different IP, access to a sensitive share, then a transfer to an external IP. No single event is alarming; the sequence raises one alert.
svg.text: A SIEM: collect, normalize, store, correlate

g.text: One correlation rule, four ordinary events:
login to A succeeds from a new IP
credential stuffing, then initial access, then exfiltration: the sequence is the signal
